dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses .INC copybooks with REPLACING, indexed file I/O, no EXEC SQL/CICS.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED / ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — specifically diagnosis classification point aggregation for hospitalization (入院) receipts including nursing care and self-pay categories
purpose.summary: ORCR0840 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates and edits diagnosis/treatment classification point data for inpatient (hospitalization) receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) representing receipt detail records, performing complex calculation and editing logic for medical billing. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2003–2008 covering numerous Japanese health insurance rule changes.

notable_features: 44 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter (GnuCOBOL style)
Multiple indexed file selects with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access on same physical file via different FDs
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
450 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but the file was decoded as latin-1, causing garbled display. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Dialect is GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) based on the // REPLACING delimiter convention and Linux/open-source context of ORCA.
